title: The logbook and signed verdicts
summary: packages/logbook is a worker on local workerd under wrangler dev: a Durable Object holds verdicts and releases, R2 holds each revision's model. POST /verdicts takes a Bearer OIDC token, verified with jose against the one issuer the environment names (RS256 only, audience, repository, ref patterns, workflow and job_workflow_ref), and stores the ref and event with the verdict. Reads are open. Beyond the verdicts it keeps a revision's model, the latest verdict per operation and environment, and the last production release, for versions and staleness in L2.04 and promotion in L2.05. The test runs the real worker against a real OIDC server (mock-oauth2-server, by digest, in Docker).
proves: A trusted token's verdict is accepted and read back with its ref and event. A forged token, another issuer's token, a wrong branch, repository, workflow or audience, no token and a non-JWT are each 401 and store nothing. State, model and release survive a restart. Nothing is left running.

captions.01-fails-first: The check before the build: the logbook doesn't exist yet, so it fails.
